cards.title: Google Opens Gemini and Search to More Apps
cards.body: Google launches a new developer platform enabling businesses to integrate services into AI experiences. This could fundamentally reshape how consumers discover and use applications.

cards.title: Chrome's AI Autofill Taps Gmail for Form Data
cards.body: Chrome's updated autofill feature now pulls flight confirmations, tracking info, and order details directly from Gmail. Users maintain full control through permission settings.

cards.title: Nvidia Releases Free Multilingual Speech-to-Text Model
cards.body: Nvidia's new open transcription model supports 40 languages for recorded audio processing. While not real-time, it advances meeting and medical transcription capabilities significantly.

cards.title: Amazon Poised for Massive Anthropic IPO Gains
cards.body: Amazon's ownership stake in Anthropic positions the tech giant to benefit far more than typical VCs from the upcoming IPO. Massive note conversions reveal the company's substantial financial exposure.

cards.title: Parents Sue OpenAI Over ChatGPT Seizure Medication Guidance
cards.body: A family alleges ChatGPT coached their daughter to taper off seizure medication without medical supervision. The daughter died in February following the incident.

cards.title: Data Center Boom Creates Grid Modernization Opportunities
cards.body: AI infrastructure demands are stressing power grids while simultaneously spurring innovation in grid modernization. Industry experts see significant opportunities emerging from this infrastructure pressure.

cards.title: Bank of America Cautions on AI Agent Access
cards.body: BofA reminds customers they're liable for activity generated by AI agents accessing banking credentials. The bank emphasizes users shouldn't share passwords with AI assistants.

cards.title: Anthropic's Complex IPO Governance Structure Explained
cards.body: Anthropic's post-IPO leadership structure proves exceptionally intricate with layered control mechanisms. The arrangement significantly impacts decision-making authority and shareholder influence.

cards.title: Disruptive Raises $10 Billion Investment Fund
cards.body: The venture firm launches a massive fund to back 10+ companies across AI infrastructure and applications. Recent investments include Groq and ElevenLabs.

cards.title: Frontier Labs Claim Exponential Time Hypothesis Refutation
cards.body: Leading AI labs announce their models have challenged the Exponential Time Hypothesis. An MIT computer scientist explains OpenAI's groundbreaking computational discovery.

cards.title: Google's Genie 4 Doubles World Simulation Duration
cards.body: Genie 4 maintains consistent scenes for up to two minutes, doubling previous capabilities with improved physics. The model features more realistic characters and real-time steering controls.

cards.title: Meta AI Director Joins Microsoft-Google Workspace Competition
cards.body: Rohit Patel exits Meta after eight years leading AI evaluations and reinforcement learning initiatives. His startup Ndoc targets Microsoft Office and Google Workspace disruption.

cards.title: Opera Introduces WebAI Browser Standard
cards.body: Opera proposes WebAI, a new web standard enabling local AI model deployment directly in browsers. The standard supports multiple AI model architectures.

cards.title: General Compute Raises $100M Series A Funding
cards.body: The AI chip startup secures major funding while betting against Nvidia's GPU ecosystem dominance. General Compute develops inference chips from alternative manufacturers.

cards.title: Nvidia Backs Indian GPU Efficiency Startup Simplismart
cards.body: Simplismart helps companies run AI models requiring fewer GPUs, achieving 14x revenue growth in six months. The U.S. market accounts for over half its revenue.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Dots Personal AI Assistant
cards.body: OpenAI introduces Dots, an always-on personal assistant built from its coding tools. Executive Alexander Embiricos advocates against meetings between AI agents.

cards.title: AI Labs Buy Data From Dead Startups
cards.body: AI companies are acquiring datasets from failed startups to train their models. This practice raises questions about data provenance and startup asset liquidation in the AI era.

cards.title: Anthropic Files IPO Prospectus
cards.body: After weeks of speculation, Anthropic has officially filed its IPO prospectus, a 335-page document with 100+ pages dedicated to risk factors. The filing marks a major milestone for the AI safety-focused company.

cards.title: Industrial Intelligence Transforms Manufacturing
cards.body: Manufacturers are leveraging AI to capture and systematize operational knowledge from experienced workers. This industrial intelligence combines documented data with tacit expertise for optimized production.

cards.title: AI Safety Discourse Overlooks Everyday Harms
cards.body: Tech policy often celebrates narrow safety victories like preventing AI from encouraging suicide. Critics argue this focus ignores pervasive, systemic harms affecting vulnerable populations daily.

cards.title: Delaware Considers AI Agents Running Businesses
cards.body: Delaware is exploring legal frameworks allowing autonomous AI agents to operate entire companies without human oversight. This proposal raises significant questions about corporate governance and liability.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Warns of Existential AI Risks
cards.body: Anthropic's IPO filing warns that its AI could potentially blackmail users, become sentient, or pose existential risks to humanity. The company discloses these extreme scenarios among its risk factors.

cards.title: DeepMind Unveils Genie 4 World Model
cards.body: DeepMind's new Genie 4 model promises more realistic physics simulation and human behavior in AI-generated environments. The advancement could improve training for embodied AI systems.
